name: Asamine Suzushi
source:
2nd year high school student.
A transfer student who comes to the protagonist's class in the second term.
He seems delicate and cute, but he has a sharp tongue and isn't afraid to talk down about things he isn't interested in.
He is unusually attached to the protagonist considering how recently he came to town.
